facts.fact: 古罗马丈夫可因妻子通奸合法杀妻，父亲可因轻微罪过杀女儿
facts.anchor: Roman husbands could legally murder their wives for adultery. Roman fathers could—and did—kill their daughters for fairly minor infractions

facts.fact: 霍拉斯笔下女巫 Canidia 的名字源自拉丁语「狗」，字面即「怪物母狗」
facts.anchor: the origin for Canidia’s name is the Latin word for “dog,” so Canidia is literally a monstrous “bitch.”

facts.fact: 维吉尔《埃涅阿斯纪》开篇讯息：女人可弃，男人才是建国与守护父权家园的必需
facts.anchor: The message of the opening of The Aeneid, then, is that women are disposable, while men are essential to founding and protecting a new fatherland.

facts.fact: 作者断言：女性若集体发声并拿起武器，父权制便无法运作
facts.anchor: Patriarchy cannot function if women raise their voices up together and take up arms against it.

facts.fact: 卢坎笔下女巫 Erichtho 最可怖之处在于她不怕神
facts.anchor: But what Lucan seems to find most terrifying about Erichtho is a trait she has that none of those other Monstrous Bitch incarnations have. She does not fear the gods.

facts.fact: 阿普列尤斯笔下 lamia 由专名变成指称一整类女性的普通名词
facts.anchor: By the end of the second century CE, then, when Apuleius is writing, “lamia” had come to denote a Monstrous Bitch who was sexually predatory, baby-slaying, spellcasting, and violent.

facts.fact: 公元一世纪起约七百年，美索不达米亚犹太家庭日常制作驱赶 Lilith 的施咒碗
facts.anchor: Starting then, and for about seven hundred years afterward, in everyday life, Mesopotamian Jewish families made incantation bowls to charm Lilith away

facts.fact: 作者结论：罗马文化并非处处驯化拉米亚，真正巨变发生在西欧
facts.anchor: So Romanitas didn’t tame and humanize Lamia everywhere. Where the full-fledged trope of Lamia undergoes truly massive change is in western Europe
